# ComingHomeIQ

> Your Home's Complete IQ — the independent home intelligence platform that gives homeowners, buyers, realtors, inspectors, contractors, and investors a verified Home Passport for every property.

ComingHomeIQ is an independent (not owned by an insurer or warranty company) home management platform. We combine homeowner-uploaded records with live public data — FEMA flood zones, NOAA storm history, EPA environmental facilities, USDA drought monitoring, county permits, and Census geocoding — to produce a verified Home Passport, a 0–100 health score, and per-system maintenance intelligence for every U.S. property.
